
\newpage

# K = `r k`

```{r}
## Ordered labels (diagnostics$cluster_reorder) for this K, all rows
cl_k     <- clusterLabels(diagnostics, k)
cl_fit   <- cl_k[fit_rows]
k_num    <- as.numeric(k)
seed_k   <- seed + as.integer(k)
n_rep    <- length(diagnostics$kmeans_res)
support  <- diagnostics$freq_df$freq[diagnostics$freq_df$n_clusters == k_num]
if (!length(support)) support <- 0
km       <- diagnostics$kmeans_full[[k]]

## Subsamples shared by the silhouette and the variable importance
samples_k <- if (any(c("silhouette", "varimp") %in% sections) && k_num > 1)
	subsampleReplicates(diagnostics$sample_indices, subsample_size, seed = seed_k)
sub_size  <- if (!is.null(samples_k)) length(samples_k[[1]])
```

Replicates selecting K = `r k`: `r support` of `r n_rep`. Between-cluster / total sum of squares of the full fit: `r round(km$betweenss / km$totss, 3)`.

```{r, results = "asis", eval = "centroids" %in% sections}
cat("\n\n## Centroid variability\n\n")
cv_k <- centroidVariability(diagnostics, k, scores_fit)
if (is.null(cv_k$stats)) {
	cat("No replicate selected K = ", k, ": no centroid variability.\n\n", sep = "")
} else {
	cat("Centroids of the ", cv_k$n_replicates, " of ", cv_k$n_total,
		" replicates that selected K = ", k, ", each matched one to one with the ",
		"full-fit centroids (Hungarian algorithm). `rmse`: root-mean-square deviation of the ",
		"replicate centroids from the full-fit centroid (spread and bias); `nrmse`: `rmse` ",
		"in standard deviations of the PC over the fit years (", fit_lab, "). ",
		"Sorted by decreasing `nrmse` (least stable first).\n\n", sep = "")
	print(knitr::kable(cv_k$stats, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3))
}
```

```{r, fig.height = 4.5, eval = "centroids" %in% sections && !is.null(cv_k$stats)}
plotCentroidVariability(cv_k)
```

```{r, results = "asis", eval = "jaccard" %in% sections && k_num > 1}
cat("\n\n## Jaccard stability\n\n")
cat("The rows of the fit years (", fit_lab, ") are assigned to the nearest centroid of ",
	"each of the ", n_rep, " replicate fits (whatever K each selected). For each cluster, ",
	"stability in one replicate is the best overlap |A and B| / |A or B| with any ",
	"replicate cluster. `jaccard`: mean over replicates; `jaccard_min`: worst replicate. ",
	"Hennig (2007): below 0.6 the cluster dissolves, above 0.75 it is stable ",
	"(dashed lines).\n\n", sep = "")
js_k <- jaccardStability(diagnostics, scores_fit, cl_fit)
print(knitr::kable(js_k$summary, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3))
```

```{r, fig.height = 3.5, eval = "jaccard" %in% sections && k_num > 1}
plotJaccard(js_k)
```

```{r, results = "asis", eval = "silhouette" %in% sections && k_num > 1}
cat("\n\n## Silhouette\n\n")
ss_k <- silhouetteStats(scores_fit, cl_fit, samples_k,
						n_null = if (null_silhouette) n_null else 0, seed = seed_k)
cat("Silhouette widths on ", ss_k$n_samples, " subsamples of ", sub_size,
	" rows of the replicate samples, fit years (", fit_lab, "). The full distance ",
	"matrix is too large, so values vary between subsamples. ",
	"Points: mean per cluster, bars: +/- 1 sd, solid line: mean over all points",
	if (!is.null(ss_k$null)) ", dashed line: mean of the null reference", ".\n\n", sep = "")
print(knitr::kable(ss_k$per_cluster, row.names = FALSE, digits = 3))
cat("\n\nMean silhouette: ", round(ss_k$overall, 3), "\n\n", sep = "")
if (!is.null(ss_k$null))
	cat("Null reference: ", ss_k$null$n, " datasets of ", ss_k$null$size,
		" points drawn uniformly in the bounding box of the fit-year PC scores, ",
		"clustered by kmeans at K = ", k, ". Null mean: ", round(ss_k$null$mean, 3),
		" (sd ", signif(ss_k$null$sd, 2), "), z = ", round(ss_k$null$z, 1), ".\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r, fig.height = 3.5, eval = "silhouette" %in% sections && k_num > 1}
plotSilhouette(ss_k)
```

```{r, results = "asis", eval = "varimp" %in% sections && k_num > 1}
cat("\n\n## Variable importance\n\n")
cat("One-vs-rest random forests (each cluster against all others) on the ",
	length(samples_k), " subsamples of the silhouette (", sub_size, " rows, fit years ",
	fit_lab, "). Mean importance over the subsamples.\n\n", sep = "")
vi_k <- varImportance(data[fit_rows, , drop = FALSE], diagnostics$pca_select,
					  cl_fit, samples = samples_k, seed = seed_k)
vi_plots <- plotVarImportance(vi_k, variable_order = diagnostics$pca_select)
```

```{r, fig.height = 3.5, eval = "varimp" %in% sections && k_num > 1}
for (p in vi_plots) print(p)
```

```{r, fig.height = 3.2, eval = "vardist" %in% sections}

```{r, results = "asis", eval = "temporal" %in% sections}
cat("\n\n## Temporal stability\n\n")
ts_k <- temporalStability(years_fit, cl_fit, threshold = share_threshold)
cat("Share of each year's rows in each cluster, fit years (", fit_lab, "). ",
	"Coverage: fraction of years with share >= ", 100 * share_threshold, "%. ",
	"Max gap: longest run of years below it between the first and the last year above it ",
	"(a cluster that disappears and reappears; a late start or an early end is not counted). ",
	"Median jump: median |log(share[y+1] / share[y])| (0.1 is about 10% change per year).\n\n",
	sep = "")
print(knitr::kable(ts_k$summary, row.names = FALSE, digits = c(0, 3, 2, 0, 3),
				   col.names = c("Cluster", "Mean share", "Coverage", "Max gap (yr)",
								 "Median jump")))
```

```{r, fig.height = 4, eval = "temporal" %in% sections}
plotTemporalShare(ts_k)
```

```{r, results = "asis", eval = "dominance" %in% sections}
cat("\n\n## Spatial dominance\n\n")

	"of the effort in each ", dom_cell_size, "-degree cell. Second figure: share of the effort of each ",
	map_cell_size, "-degree cell that belongs to each cluster (1: the cell is fished by that cluster only).\n\n",

```

```{r, fig.height = 4.5, eval = "dominance" %in% sections}
plotDominance(data[fit_rows, , drop = FALSE], cl_fit, cell_size = dom_cell_size)
```

```{r, fig.height = 0.8 + 2.2 * ceiling(k_num / 2), eval = "dominance" %in% sections}
plotClusterShare(data[fit_rows, , drop = FALSE], cl_fit, cell_size = map_cell_size)
```

```{r, results = "asis", eval = "maps" %in% sections}
map_vars <- c(CPUE = "CPUE (yellowfin numbers / effort)", mean_len = "mean length",
			  mean_hbf = "mean hooks between floats")
map_groups <- split(seq_len(k_num), ceiling(seq_len(k_num) / map_per_fig))
map_rows <- data[fit_rows, , drop = FALSE]
for (v in names(map_vars)) {
	cat("\n\n## Map of ", map_vars[[v]], "\n\n", sep = "")
	cat("Fit years (", fit_lab, "), ", map_cell_size, "-degree cells. ",
		switch(v, CPUE = "CPUE of a cell: total catch / total effort of its rows. ",
			   mean_len = "Rows with imputed lengths left out; mean weighted by the number of fish. ",
			   mean_hbf = "Rows with imputed HBF left out. "),
		"Colour scale shared by all clusters, values outside it drawn at its ends. ",
		"Above and right of each map: the same quantity by longitude and latitude band.\n\n", sep = "")
	for (g in map_groups) {
		h <- 0.8 + 3.6 * ceiling(length(g) / 2)
		cat(knitr::knit_child(text = c(
			sprintf("```{r, fig.height = %s}", h),
			"plotClusterMap(map_rows, cl_fit, v, cell_size = map_cell_size, limits = map_limits[[v]], clusters = g)",
			"```"), envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
	}
}
```

```{r, results = "asis", eval = "breakpoints" %in% sections}
cat("\n\n## Breakpoints\n\n")
bpd_k <- breakpointData(diagnostics, k, data)
bts_k <- aggregateClusterTimeSeries(bpd_k)
bbp_k <- do.call(analyseClusterBreakpoints, c(list(ts = bts_k, df = bpd_k), breakpoint_args))
cat("Monthly series of each cluster, fit years (", fit_lab, "), imputed lengths and HBF left out. ",
	"Shaded: changes found by `analyseClusterBreakpoints()`, coloured by label (black: marked common). ",
	nrow(bbp_k), " change(s) found. The plots and tables behind each change, and how to read them, ",
	"are in `breakpointReport()`.\n\n", sep = "")
if (nrow(bbp_k)) {
	tab <- table(factor(bbp_k$cluster, sort(unique(bts_k$cluster))),
				 ifelse(bbp_k$common, "common", bbp_k$label))
	print(knitr::kable(cbind(cluster = rownames(tab), as.data.frame.matrix(tab)), row.names = FALSE,
					   caption = "Changes per cluster and label"))
}
```

```{r, fig.height = 1.2 + 1.1 * as.numeric(k), eval = "breakpoints" %in% sections}
plotClusterBreakpoints(bts_k, bbp_k)
```
